name: JW Marriott Hotel Surabaya
positioning: City-center luxury hotel near Tunjungan Plaza Mall in Surabaya's shopping and business district
best_for: Travelers who want a central Surabaya base close to heritage landmarks
Families wanting a kids club, a pool and suites or serviced apartments

facts.text: The hotel is in Surabaya's city center, near Tunjungan Plaza Mall.
It sits in Surabaya's shopping and business district, minutes from the heritage landmark of Kota Lama Surabaya, Tugu Pahlawan and Sunan Ampel Mosque.
Accommodation includes expansive suites, serviced apartments and family rooms.
Beds have plush pillowtop mattresses, feather beds and soft duvets.
The Family Kids Club offers a safe and fun-filled playground for children.
The hotel has a 24-hour gym and massage service.
The health club has sauna rooms and steam rooms.
The spa offers massages, including couples massages.
The Executive Lounge serves afternoon tea, beer and wine, and cocktails.
Uppercut Steakhouse serves fine-quality meats, including dry-aged beef.
Tang Palace serves Cantonese flavors and hand-crafted dim sum.
The hotel is Green Key certified.

highlights.text: The hotel has a pool with panoramic views.
The JW Terrace by the Pool venue hosts movie nights.
The Presidential Suite has two bedrooms, a balcony and a rooftop terrace, with executive lounge access.
Rooms have marble bathrooms with rainfall showers.
Imari Japanese Restaurant has a sushi bar, teppan-style cooking and fresh grilled seafood and meat.

considerations.text: The closest airport, Surabaya Juanda International Airport, is approximately 35 km from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may lack resort-style amenities.
